name: Midnight Rose Feather Fascinator
description: A stylish black party hairpiece featuring a round net base layered with a crisp mesh black bow. The center is styled with three black glitter roses, each accented with a sparkling crystal stone, and finished with soft, fluffy black feathers for a classic, dressy touch.
description2: It is lightweight, easy to clip into the hair, and holds securely for long events. This hairpiece can be customized in any color to perfectly match your dress.
